user.title: Add E-Ink ESL
user.description: Pick a discovered shelf label, or enter the Bluetooth address manually. One config entry is created per device.

manual.title: Manual Bluetooth address
manual.description: Enter the tag MAC address if it is not listed (wake the label so it advertises).

bluetooth_confirm.title: E-Ink ESL
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

panel.title: Panel model
panel.description: Choose the display size/colors for {address}. This sets the type code sent with the display command.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported e-ink ESL tag

upload_image.name: Upload image
upload_image.description: Encode an image and transfer it to an e-ink shelf label over Bluetooth.

image.name: Image
image.description: Base64 image data (or a data URL), or a file path under the Home Assistant config directory.

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: How to fit the image onto the panel.

clear_screen.name: Clear screen
clear_screen.description: Clear the shelf label to a solid color (connects briefly, then disconnects).
